physicalNotes: Radius 0.0918906 Jupiter radii from Barkaoui et al. 2024 (2024A&A...687A.264B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract): 6,569.4 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Barkaoui et al. 2024 (2024A&A...687A.264B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...687A.264B/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.01258541 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
